style_notes: Agreed unit price: do not state the price in the price clause. State it only in a Price Schedule headed Schedule 1, placed after the last numbered clause and before the signature block, as plain lines in the form Item: <name> and Unit price: PKR <amount> per unit. In the price clause say only that unit prices are set out in Schedule 1 and that an invoice shall not exceed them.
extra_decoys: The Vendor shall replace defective Equipment within five (5) days of written notice from the Buyer.
